subject: Diet
hook: DIET IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The word 'Diet' is not just about nutrition or weight loss; it is also the formal name for various national legislative assemblies, including Japan's bicameral parliament.
angle_support: National Diet, Japan's bicameral legislature, in its current form since 1947
title: The Surprising Political Meaning Behind the Word "Diet"
description: Most people think a diet is only about food, but the term also refers to legislative bodies. From Japan’s modern parliament to historic Imperial assemblies, "diet" has a long political legacy.
narration: DIET IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture diet as meals or calorie counting. In reality you, 'diet' also names the formal parliamentary assemblies of nations like Japan, Germany, and Sweden and others today. Japan’s National Diet, established under the 1947 constitution, consists of the House of Representatives and the House of Councillors. The term also appears in historic bodies such as the Imperial Diet of the Holy Roman Empire. Parliamentary power hides behind the same word as your meals daily
